Direction for questions :

In the stack, eleven boxes from A to K are stacked one on top of the other, with the bottom box being numbered 1 and the top box being numbered 11. Not necessarily every box is in the exact alphabetical order.

Box E is maintained at an even number. Three boxes above box E is, where box K is housed. Between Box K and Box B, which is stored beneath Box K, there is just one box. Box B is maintained at a prime numbered position. Between Box B and Box G, which is not kept above Box E, there are only two boxes. Box H’s position is twice the number denoting position of box J. Box D is stored beneath Box J, although not directly below. Between box H and box I, only three boxes are there. Box A is stored beneath Box C. One of the spaces below box I is retained for box F. Box F is not placed at third from the top.


Which box is at the topmost position?

Direction for questions :

Seven individuals, L, M, N, O, P, Q, and R, will take separate exams in seven distinct months (of the same year), namely January, February, April, May, July, September, and December, however they may not appear in that sequence. They all enjoy diverse TV show genres, such as Family, Action, Comedy, Reality, Animated, History, and Thriller, though not always in that order.

 O will take exam in a month, which consists of 30 days. Between the person who like animated shows and O, there will only be one person. The person who enjoys action will show up for the exam right before the person who enjoys animated shows. That person who enjoys thrillers will not take exam during either 30- or 31-day months. Between the person who likes Thriller and Q, there will only be two candidates for the exam. M dislikes action shows and will appear in the exam just after Q. P likes History shows and will take exam in December. R will take exam right before N. The person who enjoys family shows will take exam in a month with thirty-one days. Comedy shows are not O's thing.


Who likes Family based TV shows?
